description: Redco Textiles Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 17 October 1991 and describes its operations as vertically integrated from the manufacturing of fibre through to fabric; it is ISO 9001 certified. Its principal activities are the manufacture and sale of yarn and grey fabric. The registered office is at 78-E, Blue Area, Islamabad.
headOffice: Redco Plaza, 4th Floor, 78-E, Blue Area, Islamabad 44000, Pakistan
